purpose: Audience profiles change emphasis — never the underlying facts.

profiles.label: General technology users
profiles.summaryHint: Prefer plain-language patches and vendor guidance.

profiles.label: Home lab enthusiasts
profiles.summaryHint: Emphasize self-hosted software, patches, and learning from past incidents.

profiles.label: Linux users
profiles.summaryHint: Lift open-source library and Linux-relevant advisories.

profiles.label: Developers
profiles.summaryHint: Emphasize libraries, CVEs, and dependency hygiene.

profiles.label: IT administrators
profiles.summaryHint: Prioritize patch bulletins, KEV signals, and operational advisories.

profiles.label: Educators
profiles.summaryHint: Prefer teaching cases, timelines, and calm historical context.

profiles.label: Researchers
profiles.summaryHint: Lift primary sources and deeper technical reading.

profiles.label: Small businesses
profiles.summaryHint: Emphasize ransomware awareness, backups context, and vendor patches — calmly.
